title: Equality of sheaf maps with finite free source near a stalk
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], r a natural number, y∈V an open neighbourhood, and M,N sheaves of modules on V [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose M is isomorphic to the restriction to V of the free rank-r module on Y [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. If maps f,g:M→N become equal after module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] along V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV, then for every open U≤V containing y there is an open W≤U containing y such that the direct restrictions of f,g from V to W are equal.

proof.text: The source isomorphism supplies r generating sections on V, carried to generators by restriction. Apply the natural pullback stalk comparison at the closed point of Spec O_{Y,y}; the local ring map there is an isomorphism. Hence equality of pullback maps implies equality of the germs in N of the two images of each generator. The comparison applies to the Mathlib pullback by the canonical isomorphism between left adjoints of the same pushforward.

Apply the germ equality criterion to the two images of each of the finitely many generators and intersect the resulting opens with U. Both maps agree on the restricted generators and hence everywhere. For r=0 take W=U.

proof_origin.place: Finite-generator equality portion of the finite germ argument; complex and homotopy reduction proved in the parent module.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_restrict_eq_of_pullback_eq
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (r : ℕ) (y : Y) (V : Y.Opens) (hyV : y ∈ V)
    (M N : V.toScheme.Modules)
    (hM : Nonempty (M ≅ (restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))))
    (f g : M ⟶ N)
    (hfg : (Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).map f =
      (Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).map g)
    (U : Y.Opens) (hUV : U ≤ V) (hyU : y ∈ U) :
    ∃ (W : Y.Opens) (hWU : W ≤ U), y ∈ W ∧
      (restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE (hWU.trans hUV))).map f =
      (restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE (hWU.trans hUV))).map g
